ideas.text: An AI that submits your expense report before you have time to feel bad about the airport wine.
A bot that categorizes receipts from photos so blurry they were clearly taken in a moving taxi.
An app that detects when you've been sitting on 3 months of expenses and submits them all with a single tap.
A tool that converts 'working dinner' into a description of what was actually discussed, if anything.
An AI that checks your expense against company policy before you submit it so finance doesn't have to embarrass you later.
A bot that detects when your per diem doesn't cover a meal in the city you were asked to travel to and files the gap.
An app that reconstructs a lost receipt from your bank statement, GPS data, and the reasonable assumption of what you ate.
A tool that detects when an expense is being declined for a rule nobody told you about and locates that rule.
An AI that estimates how long until your reimbursement hits your account and schedules a follow-up if it doesn't.
A bot that detects when a finance reviewer's question about your expense is actually easier to answer than it looks.
An app that generates a business justification for an expense that is technically valid but requires some creative framing.
A tool that tracks how much of your own money is currently owed to you by your employer, in real time.
An AI that detects when a travel booking costs $40 more than the cheapest option and writes the justification for you.
A bot that reminds you to photograph the receipt before you throw it away, which you were about to do.
An app that converts a group dinner receipt into 4 separate expense reports, split fairly and correctly.
A tool that detects when an expense approval chain requires 4 signatures for a $12 coffee and files a system complaint.
An AI that identifies which expenses are definitely fine, which are fine but risky, and which are a cry for help.
A bot that detects when you've accidentally put a personal charge on the corporate card and handles it quietly.
An app that reconciles your corporate card statement automatically so the monthly deadline stops being a crisis.
A tool that detects when an expense policy hasn't been updated since before the company went remote.
An AI that generates the mileage log you should have been keeping for the past 6 months from your calendar and maps.
A bot that converts the company's 40-page expense policy into a 1-page summary of things that will get you in trouble.
An app that detects when you're about to expense something the company will reject and suggests the right account code.
A tool that tracks how long expense approvals sit in your manager's inbox and sends a nudge formatted as a business need.
An AI that detects when a meal limit hasn't kept up with inflation in the cities your team is required to travel to.
A bot that detects when you're about to submit an expense report for a trip that was actually fun and audits your framing.
An app that detects when a finance team rejection email is incorrect and drafts your polite but firm appeal.
A tool that generates a per diem optimization guide for each city you're sent to so you don't lose money eating out.
An AI that detects when an expense has been sitting in 'under review' for longer than the reimbursement policy allows.
A bot that detects when your expense categories were changed without notice and re-categorizes old submissions.
An app that lets you photograph a menu item, identify the price, and check if it's within policy before ordering.
A tool that calculates the total interest you've effectively donated to your employer by floating business expenses.
An AI that detects when someone on your team submitted a duplicate expense and handles the conversation diplomatically.
A bot that detects when an upgrade to business class would actually be cheaper than the cheapest economy option and books it.
An app that tracks every out-of-pocket work expense you've absorbed because submitting it felt like too much effort.
A tool that detects when 'this one's on me' has become a recurring pattern and calculates the total cost to you.
An AI that identifies which coworker always lets other people pay at team dinners and quantifies the pattern over time.
A bot that detects when a client entertainment limit is lower than the restaurant's minimum price point for a group.
An app that photographs, categorizes, and submits every receipt the moment you get it, before you lose it.
A tool that detects when year-end is approaching and notifies you of all the expenses you haven't submitted yet.
An AI that detects when an expense report form hasn't been updated since the company switched currencies.
A bot that finds your most commonly submitted expense categories and creates a template so you stop starting from scratch.
An app that detects when you were asked to travel last-minute and automatically flags the inflated costs for pre-approval.
A tool that converts a foreign currency receipt into your reimbursement currency using the exact rate on the day of purchase.
An AI that detects when a conference registration fee is technically an expense but will definitely raise questions.
A bot that generates a monthly expense health check so you don't discover a problem 90 days after the trip.
An app that detects when your manager approved an expense your manager shouldn't have approved and handles the downstream.
A tool that identifies which of your home office purchases would qualify as a tax deduction if the company won't reimburse them.
An AI that detects when you were charged twice for the same hotel night and drafts the dispute.
A bot that calculates the total value of unreimbursed work expenses across your entire career at this company.
An app that detects when a team lunch was expensed by one person for the 6th consecutive time and rotates the responsibility.
An app that detects when a company's expense system was last updated and cross-references it with the year it was clearly designed.
A tool that auto-splits a restaurant bill across 3 cost centers so nobody has to do the math at the table.
An AI that detects when a 'working lunch' was actually a lunch and suggests an accurate categorization.
A bot that tracks your average reimbursement timeline and sends your manager a note when it exceeds company policy.
An app that detects when you're about to expense a team outing that costs more than your own monthly food budget.
A tool that finds the cheapest hotel that still has functioning wifi and doesn't appear in any true crime podcasts.
